 (GIRISH CHATNI)
 XXIX ACJM, BENGALURU  3  C.C.No.50373/2022  JUDGMENT The P.S.I., of K.R.Puram Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 & 2 for the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A, 323, 504, 506 R/w Sec.34 of Indian Penal Code.
2.

BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :
It is the case of the complainant that, on 04.06.2017, the CW.1 was got married with accused No.1 at Hosakote and both the accused and CW.1 are having daughter.
It is further alleged that, the accused No.1 and CW.1 used to reside at K.V.Extention, Near by Sai Baba Temple along with accused No.2.
At that time, the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected CW.1 to cruelty by harassing her mentally as to she has not begotten male child.

Thereafter, the complainant along with accused No.1 and 2 at Brundavana Extension, there also the accused No.1 and 2 have subjected CW.1 to cruelty, abused her in filthy language, assaulted by hands and threatened her with dire consequences.
Such being the case on 23.11.2021 at 7.30 PM, accused No.2 picked up quarrel with CW.1
, at that time, the complainant submitted that, the accused No.1 used to C.C.No.50373/2022 consume alcohol for that she is not preparing food deliciously.

It is further alleged that, the accused No.1 and 2 assaulted CW.1 on cheeks and thereafter, the complainant called her father, the accused No.1 took the mobile phone of the complainant and the complainant and her daughter were forced to go to parental house.

Based on the written complaint Kumari.R vs Pampamani Srinivas on 4 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189954583/
2 lodged by C.W.1
, C.W.9 registered the case against accused No.1 and 2 in P.S. Crime No.370/2021 for the offence punishable under sections 498(a), 323, 504, 506 R/w 34 of IPC.

Investigating Officer/CW.9 investigated the matter and after completion of the investigation has submitted final report against the accused No.1 and 2 for the above said offences.
3. Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above mentioned offence alleged against the accused No.1 & 2 and registered the criminal case against them.
4. After registering the case, the accused No.1 and 2 have appeared and were released on bail as the accused No.1 and 2 have obtained anticipatory bail.
Copies of the final report and its' enclosures were furnished to them in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charges.
Hence, charges framed and read C.C.No.50373/2022 over to the accused persons.

They pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
5.

In order to prove the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 09 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.7 and closed its side.
In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused No.1 and 2, recording of their statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
6. Heard the arguments of both parties.
Perused the materials on record.
3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all in furtherance of common intention have abused CW.1 in filthy language and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 R/w 34 of IPC?
4. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all in furtherance of common intention have threatened CW.1 with dire consequences and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.506 R/w 34 of IPC ?
5. What Order?

My findings on the above points are as under:

3  Point Nos.1 to 4 : In the Negative.
Point No.5 :

As per the final order  for the following;
 REASONS  9. POINT Nos.1 to 4 :-
As these four points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repeti- tion of facts & evidence.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon Seven documents.
10.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused persons, the prosecution has examined the complainant / victim CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, nothing has been elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused persons.
On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has compromised the matter with the accused Nos.1 and 2.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst.
Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.
As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused persons.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused persons.
Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused No.1 and 2 and hence, the Point Nos.1 to 4 are answered in the "Negative".

12. Point No.5 :- In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 and 2 are acquitted of the offence punishable under sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 R/w 34 of Indian Penal Code.
The Bail bonds and surety bonds of the accused persons shall be in force for the period of 6 months and thereafter it shall be cancelled without further orders.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer and typed by her, corrected by me and then signed and pronounced in the Open Court on this date the 04 th day of March, 2025.)
(GIRISH CHATNI)
